items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: The first time I ever sing, I sing Little Lies of James.

ctx.x: Who sang it? Who sang it? Who sang it? Who sang it? I kinda remember.

It's three in my day sometime. She didn't have many people sing around it. And this was, you know, this youngers always had to sing. In my days sometimes, we didn't have many people singing on it, you know, with our band. And this was, you know, these youngers, always have an entertainer to sing. But in my days, we never had nobody sing with us. Sometimes we play for the white people and have a couple of them in there to sing, where they ask us to play behind them, complimenting like that. Where did you first sing Little Lies of James?
